title: The last room, apparently
scenario: A booking-site message says your hotel has a payment problem and your room will be released in 20 minutes unless you re-enter your card on an external page. The message appears inside the same thread as your real reservation.

answers.A: Call the hotel using a number from its official site and ask whether your reservation is at risk.
answers.B: Pay through the external page because the message appeared inside your genuine booking thread.
answers.C: Open the booking in the platform and contact the hotel or platform through its built-in support tools.

explanation: Real booking accounts can be compromised, so the location of a message is not proof that its payment link is safe.
proTip: A familiar thread can still contain an unfamiliar payment destination.
